blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. struggled to keep up with Filipino tennis star Alex Eala, even committing a double fault, during a friendly exhibition match on Tuesday. Meanwhile, Education Secretary Sonny Angara mounted a comeback and scored a point against the world-ranked 21-year-old Filipina. Marcos and Angara joined Eala for a ceremonial tennis match
